name: structured-extract
description: The ticket 11.3 canonical structured-output workflow (ADR-013). An `llm` extract step declares an `output_format` with a JSON Schema: the engine asks the mock provider for native structured output, deterministically JSON-repairs the completion when it arrives as text instead, and runs an implicit `json_schema` validator over the result — so an output that cannot be shaped into schema-conforming JSON dead-letters as validation_failed rather than flowing on malformed. The structured `.json` then flows into a downstream `record` step through `${{ steps.extract.output.json.echo }}`. It runs entirely offline on the mock (model `mock/sim-1`), whose native structured answer is a JSON object `{"echo": <text>}` matching the schema; swapping the model id and schema for a real provider makes it a live extraction workflow unchanged.

config.prompt: Extract the salient text from this document as JSON: ${{ run.params.document }}
